From: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@cirrus-ware.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: New vendor onboarding — PO number request and spend caps

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood's onboarding checklist yesterday. We're ready to move the procurement step forward. Two asks to unblock our procurement team:

1) Can you confirm whether Cirrus Ware will get a single PO number per month or per-deployment (we anticipate multiple deployments across regions)?
2) We submitted the onboarding form (attached) — can you confirm the initial spend cap the finance team will apply while routing for approval? The onboarding form has our anticipated monthly spend broken down by deployment and three line items that sometimes get merged on your side.

Attached: cirrus_onboard_form_v2.xlsx and PO_lineitems_initial.csv

If helpful, we can hop on a quick call — otherwise we'd appreciate a confirmation and any next steps so I can update our procurement team.

Best,
Anna Gomez
Vendor Ops | Cirrus Ware
anna.gomez@cirrus-ware.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@cirrus-ware.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO number request and spend caps

Hi Anna — thanks for the form, looks good overall. Quick answers and next steps: 

- PO numbering: Default behavior is one active PO per account per billing cycle (monthly), but we can issue per-deployment POs if you need them for cost-center mapping. That requires a short mapping table from your side (deployment -> cost center).
- Initial spend cap: Finance typically sets a provisional cap during verification. For new partners we default to $50k/month unless procurement requests an exception and provides supporting docs (recent credit references or corporate card guarantees).

One question: I see three line items in PO_lineitems_initial.csv that are currently aggregated into a single charge in our billing pipeline. To avoid mischarges we prefer an explicit "bundle mapping" that tells us whether those items should stay separate on the PO or be billed as a single SKU. Karthik — can you weigh in on the best way to map these?

I'll hold on issuing any provisional PO numbers until we confirm the mapping.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Vendor Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@cirrus-ware.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Jul 2027 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — PO number request and spend caps

Monica / Anna —

Thanks for the context. A couple of practical constraints from procurement: 

1) Our ledger requires that each line item on a PO maps to a single internal GL code. If vendor items are bundled but billed separately, we see mismatches during reconciliation.
2) For new vendors we can temporarily issue a monthly provisional PO (PO-PROV-202707-CIRRUS-001) tied to the $50k provisional cap. If Cirrus needs per-deployment POs, we'll need the mapping table + a short justification for splitting, and this will push final approval by ~3 business days.

Suggested path:
- Anna: please produce a corrected CSV with an additional column "preferred_po_behavior" with values: "separate" or "bundle" for each line. If left blank we'll default to "bundle".
- Monica / Ben: I'll provision a monthly PO once the corrected CSV arrives and finance signs off.

Ben — can you provision the PO number once we have the corrected CSV and I mark approvals in Coupa?

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Procurement | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

Hi team — thanks, we updated the CSV per Karthik's guidance and marked the three entries as follows: two as "separate" (they bill to distinct cost centers) and one as "bundle" (a platform fee). Attached: PO_lineitems_corrected.csv.

We also attached a short vendor credit reference. If $50k provisional cap is acceptable, please go ahead and provision PO-PROV-202707-CIRRUS-001 and confirm whether we should expect a single invoice per month or multiple invoices mapped to the per-deployment PO in the future.

Attachments: PO_lineitems_corrected.csv (CSV), vendor_credit_reference.pdf (referenced)
